acceptanceCriteria: the failure path reads the child output only after Wait returns or through a synchronized writer
a forced failure of the test under -race reports no data race (one mutation proving the check bites)
body: Residual from the V1-1353 lane (PR #950, merge-base 883caa3d2, 2026-10-16). Under go test -race on internal/tasks/store, when TestPSRForegroundSignals takes its failure path, internal/tasks/store/pool_sweep_test.go:137 reads the child process output buffer while the os/exec copier goroutine is still writing it; the race detector reports it. Related: V1-1000 (the same test fails under load); this ticket is the race in the failure-reporting path, distinct from the load failure. Expected: the test waits for the command (or uses a synchronized buffer) before reading output. Actual: unsynchronized read, -race report.
title: tests: data race in TestPSRForegroundSignals failure path (pool_sweep_test.go:137 reads the child output buffer while os/exec still writes it)
